parameters.name: input_dir
parameters.description: Input directory containing extraction.h5 and metadata files
parameters.help_text: Input directory containing extraction.h5 and metadata files

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Output directory where results are saved
parameters.help_text: Output directory where results are saved

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: dF/F algorithm: 'triexp' (parametric 3-pass triexponential baseline fit) or 'percentile' (rolling-percentile baseline).
parameters.help_text: dF/F algorithm: 'triexp' (parametric 3-pass triexponential baseline fit) or 'percentile' (rolling-percentile baseline).

parameters.name: long_window
parameters.description: Percentile baseline window (s). Used only when method='percentile'.
parameters.help_text: Percentile baseline window (s). Used only when method='percentile'.

parameters.name: short_window
parameters.description: Short detrending window (s). Used only when method='percentile'.
parameters.help_text: Short detrending window (s). Used only when method='percentile'.

parameters.name: inactive_percentile
parameters.description: Inactive percentile for F0. Used only when method='percentile'.
parameters.help_text: Inactive percentile for F0. Used only when method='percentile'.

parameters.name: noise_method
parameters.description: Noise estimator ('mad'|'fft'|'welch'). Used only when method='percentile'.
parameters.help_text: Noise estimator ('mad'|'fft'|'welch'). Used only when method='percentile'.

parameters.name: sigma_anneal_steps
parameters.description: IRLS sigma-annealing steps (aind_ophys_utils.baseline_fitting.nonlinear_fit). 1 (default) or 2 disable annealing (single-jump); 3 enables one intermediate step; 4 uses two; higher graduates further but exceeds the internal maxiter=5. Used only when method='triexp'.
parameters.help_text: IRLS sigma-annealing steps (aind_ophys_utils.baseline_fitting.nonlinear_fit). 1 (default) or 2 disable annealing (single-jump); 3 enables one intermediate step; 4 uses two; higher graduates further but exceeds the internal maxiter=5. Used only when method='triexp'.

parameters.name: triexp_config_overrides
parameters.description: JSON object of overrides for set_dff_config. Keys must be a subset of set_dff_config's keyword arguments (except sigma_anneal_steps, which has its own dedicated field above); any key omitted falls back to the function's default. Used only when method='triexp'.
